latest_release.name: v12.5.0
latest_release.body:
## v12.5.0 (2026-11-12)

#### Notable changes

**New options**
* `WsAdapter` takes `maxPayload`, the largest message a client may send (1 MB by default, was 100 MB; a gateway's own `maxPayload` takes precedence, `0` lifts the limit); a larger message closes the connection with code 1009 – [109e52cd9b](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/109e52cd9be3cbd59b9a146303f8af754226b9be)
* `IoAdapter` takes `maxWaitingMessages`, the number of a client's messages of one event that may wait beyond those being handled (10,000 by default; `Infinity` lifts it) – [c98b5f782e](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/c98b5f782e06c0beb672ebdb8b285cc5beeaaee7)
* TCP server: `maxConcurrentMessages` (1000 per connection by default; `0` lifts it) – [42c619cd69](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/42c619cd692ddf3557998a1fecca2ecbbbfb1b0c)
* gRPC server: `maxPendingResponses` (1000 by default; `0` disables), after which a streaming call whose client leaves its responses unread fails with `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` – [ce6d44d858](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/ce6d44d858ee4f109516ea58d200c708b4c976a2)
* Redis server: `maxWildcardChannelLength` (1024 characters by default; `0` disables) for requests matched through a wildcard subscription – [074dcf7c60](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/074dcf7c60fa7d508e21b7a435af668987bfb1b3)
* RabbitMQ: `maxMessageSize` (16 MiB by default) for messages and replies decoded as JSON – [da6b3fc5bc](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/da6b3fc5bc2f036501fac7501352d89c0aafcb8f)
* `@nestjs/platform-fastify`: multipart `limits.jsonFieldsSize` (1 MiB by default) for the fields of a request sent as `application/json` – [958316696f](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/958316696fcbc166ee03d94fc52b873c5f5bfd2f)

**New defaults and behaviour changes**
* TCP: `maxBufferSize` defaults to 16 Mi characters (was 128 Mi), in both directions – [55da0b0d33](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/55da0b0d335b0c994a49331c0ce7d5a350973da3) – and now applies to each packet rather than to everything received in one read, so a burst of small packets no longer closes the connection ([#18502](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/issues/18502)) – [ce285e6ad3](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/ce285e6ad300a9eebe0adf8c37931caa357cb112)
* TCP server: an empty or unset `host` now listens on localhost; set `host: '0.0.0.0'` (or `'::'`) to listen on every interface – [4196d3655d](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/4196d3655df798662b138453268b1a7a0a870491)
* `@nestjs/platform-express`, `@nestjs/platform-node`: multipart requests default to at most 1000 parts, which also caps a `fields`, `files` or `maxCount` above 1000 unless `limits.parts` is raised – [b2bbc17122](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/b2bbc17122b8478dbdf2f6e2fe3a06ad3ef72e8d)
* An upload option a route sets to `undefined` or `null` now keeps the module's value; use `Infinity` to lift a limit – [7bc8d9121e](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/7bc8d9121e2bb4392cb235aaa85fecab07a990db)
* A limit option given as `NaN` (e.g. `Number(process.env.UNSET)`) now gets its default instead of turning the limit off, for TCP, Kafka, `WsAdapter`, `IoAdapter`, the validation pipes and `@Sse()` – [8209d1c8be](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/8209d1c8be258335da2e6e57a9a15ed582933d52), [f956177a0e](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/f956177a0eabcb6bbb2f530a8da30e5c421b3e27), [5b58a6e89f](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/5b58a6e89f80ace7bed0f6878e8bdab4b1256e75)
* `ClassSerializerInterceptor` and `StandardSchemaSerializerInterceptor` serialize each object a streamed HTTP response yields, so `@Exclude()`, groups and schemas apply to every line of NDJSON – [8217f2b3b8](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/8217f2b3b8c42390f598c3977141d2b76cdd2fa2)
* `@Sse()`: while Node.js has paused the socket of a client, a `:` comment is written every 5 s, so that a client that left is noticed – [cd963b19bd](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/cd963b19bdfcce5041632d3acef8023c673489c8)
